verdict.rationale: Unreal's Python scripting API and editor automation docs explicitly describe automating repetitive tasks across many Assets/Actors (e.g., batch LOD generation, asset import pipelines, placement/layout automation) and the Asset Manager provides bulk discovery/loading/auditing across large asset sets. This directly supports bulk operations across many items, though evidence is all first-party docs without hands-on validation of large-scale bulk runs or AI-agent-driven usage. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of bulk operations succeeding at scale, explicit AI-agent-driven bulk workflow examples.
